basics.label: Ph.D. Student, Electrical and Computer Engineering, University of Southern California
basics.summary: Research interests: human-centered video understanding, temporal dynamics in the context of medical imaging, clinical trials, and seamless dyadic interaction.

Temasek Community Action and Leadership Exchange (2019)

education.area: Electrical and Computer Engineering (Advisor: Shrikanth Narayanan)

awards.title: Honda Young Engineers and Scientists Award

projects.name: Speech Production on Real-time MRI Video
projects.summary: Video world models, diffusion synthesis, and multimodal encoders for real-time MRI of the vocal tract.
highlights: Built Arti-JEPA, a video world model for rtMRI speech production analysis that doubles cross-domain phoneme decoding over pretrained baselines and supports applications to clinical speech (CSL submission)

Developed Speech2rtMRI, the first audio-guided diffusion model for real-time MRI synthesis of the vocal tract, with up to 34% of samples misidentified as authentic by expert phoneticians (ICASSP 2025)
Engineered a multimodal video encoder for real-time MRI fusing optical flow with 6-channel region-of-interest inputs, reducing phoneme recognition error rate by 5% (ICASSP 2026)

projects.name: Temporal Dynamics in Human Speech and Gestures
projects.summary: Motion-centric video understanding and rigorous evaluation of human behavior models.
highlights: Developed MOOSE, a motion-centric video encoder for fine-grained human activity understanding (TMLR submission)
Improved detection of atypical motor behaviors in autism by 6% accuracy, with enhanced saliency-based explainability

Audited evaluation practices in co-speech gesture research, showing learned judges exploit speaker and session shortcuts (0.92 accuracy with no true coupling), and proposed 3 controls for rigorous evaluation (ICASSP 2027 submission)

projects.name: Egocentric Officer-Civilian Interaction on Traffic Stops
projects.summary: Large-scale analysis of body-worn camera footage.
highlights: Designed a video embedding extraction pipeline and setting selection on 30K+ body-worn videos of traffic stops
Analyzed 2K+ annotated videos of multimodal collaborative officer-civilian activity from multiple views

projects.name: Multimodal Human Trust Perception
highlights: Collected and benchmarked the EVALUATE dataset (920 ads), exposing gaps in emotion and trust perception
Showed via label-stability analysis that survey design systematically shifts human annotator judgments

projects.name: Image Severity Ranking in Ophthalmology
projects.summary: Expert-centric severity representation learning for medical images.
highlights: Designed ConPrO, a severity representation learning framework combining contrastive learning and preference optimization, outperforming state-of-the-art methods by 6% in F1 score (CVPRW 2024)
Developed SiameN and SEMISE, expert-centric severity ranking models, improving IoU explainability by 6% and ranking performance by 3% in F1 score (ISBI 2025, EMBC 2025, Ophthalmology Science 2025)
